items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: I wonder if some of them are known, but Buddy Rich played drums.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Book Cleft and later for Ver.
I wonder if some of them are known, but Buddy Rich played drums. Do they have his name down there?
Yeah, right. Buddy Rich did play drums on some of these. This looks like a studio. Yeah, it is a studio.
